from pathlib import Path

code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Find the repeated-color palette strip (three identical rows).
    strips=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w):
            vals=[grid[r+i][c] for i in range(3)]
            if vals[0]!=0 and vals[0]==vals[1]==vals[2]:
                strips.append((c, vals[0]))
    # palette runs horizontally
    cols=sorted(c for c,v in strips)
    colors=[grid[h-4][c] for c in cols]
    # locate the repeated motif as the 3-row nonzero shape
    motif_rows=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        cells=[(rr-r,c,grid[rr][c]) for rr in range(r,r+3) for c in range(w) if grid[rr][c]!=0]
        if cells and all(v==cells[0][2] for dr,c,v in cells):
            motif_rows.append((r,cells))
    # Choose 3-row connected motif occurrence, excluding palette strip.
    candidates=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        cells=[(rr-r,c,grid[rr][c]) for rr in range(r,r+3) for c in range(w) if grid[rr][c] not in (0,) and not (c in cols and grid[rr][c] in colors)]
        if cells and any(grid[rr][c] == 1 for rr, c in [(r+dr,c) for dr,c,v in cells]):
            candidates.append((r,cells))
    # Prefer shape rows containing color 1; preserve its exact relative geometry.
    r0=min((r for r in range(h-2) if any(grid[r+i][c]==1 for i in range(3) for c in range(w))), default=0)
    pts=[(rr-r0,c) for rr in range(r0,r0+3) for c in range(w) if grid[rr][c]==1]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr,c in pts:
            rr=i*3+dr
            if rr<h: out[rr][c]=color
    return out
'''
